method: Google Support documentation (support.google.com/drive). Sources: 'How to use Google Drive' (2424384), 'View & reorder your files and folders' (2375177), 'Delete files in Google Drive' (2375102), 'Organize your files in Google Drive' (2375091), 'Check activity & file versions' (2409045), 'Upload files & folders to Google Drive' (2424368), 'Use buttons in your Drive toolbar' (13318592), 'Search for files in Google Drive' (2375114).

entry_screen.title: My Drive
entry_screen.description: Opens to the My Drive view showing files and folders the user has created or added. Displays a list of recently-accessed and frequently-used files.

surfaces.title: My Drive
surfaces.description: Main view showing files and folders owned by or added to the user's Drive
primary_actions: New (dropdown: New folder, File upload, Folder upload, Create Google Doc, Create Google Sheet, Create Google Slide, Create Google Form)
controls: Filter chips (by Type, People, Modified, more sorting options)
Folder placement toggle (Folders on top / Files and folders intermingled)

basic_chips: Type (documents, spreadsheets, presentations, PDFs, images, videos, etc.)

surfaces.title: Shared with me
surfaces.description: View of files and folders that others have shared with the user

surfaces.title: Recent
surfaces.description: List of files recently accessed by the user

surfaces.title: Starred
surfaces.description: View of files and folders the user has starred for quick access

surfaces.title: Trash
surfaces.description: View of files and folders in the user's trash. Files are permanently deleted after 30 days.

surfaces.title: File Details & Activity Panel
surfaces.description: Right-side panel showing file information, activity history, sharing permissions, and version history. Accessed via Info button or right-click menu.
access_methods: Click Info button in top right

surfaces.title: File/Folder Upload
surfaces.description: Interface for uploading files and folders to Google Drive
primary_actions: Drag and drop (supported in Chrome and Firefox)

state_dependent_rules.available_when: user is the owner of the file
state_dependent_rules.unavailable_when: user does not own the file (only 'Remove' is available)

state_dependent_rules.available_when: file is owned by someone else and has been shared with the user
state_dependent_rules.result: removes file from user's Drive but others retain access
permanently deletes all files in trash at once
immediately and permanently deletes the file

state_dependent_rules.timing: 30 days after file is moved to trash

state_dependent_rules.result: adds or removes file from Starred view

state_dependent_rules.available_when: user owns the file or has edit permissions
